contexts.text: The modification of the rays of light in the rain drops.
The modification of spiritual light...
The rays of light which fall upon and as it were modify them are from the Lord.
There is a spiritual modification which (must) be perceived by man by means of colours.

Every colour consists of innumerable rays, so that myriads constitute one general Perceptible, which is as it were a modification of the origins of light from the celestial and spiritual things which produce it.
But, in the Spiritual World, all modifications which come forth from the influx of life are spiritual. Hence come such differences of intelligence and wisdom.

The imagination of man is... the forms and shapes of such things as he has taken up with the sight of the body, wonderfully varied, and, so to speak, modified. But his interior imagination, or thought, is... the forms and shapes of such things as he has drawn in with the sight of his mind, still more wonderfully varied, and, so to speak, modified.
Spiritual things, which are of truth, are made by modifications of heavenly light...
The ear, with its forms constructed therein to the modifications of (the aerial atmosphere).
Unless there were interior modifications, which are of life (in the ear), to which correspond the exterior modifications which are of the air, hearing would not come forth.
Without a substance... there is not any modification...
The eye is modified by a more subtle atmosphere than the ear.
Intelligence and wisdom are... an eminent modification of heavenly light.
The eye has been formed correspondently to the modifications (of the ether and of light).
Colours, there, in their essence, are variations, or, so to speak, modifications of intelligence and wisdom. AC 4677.
The variegations or modifications of that light are the derivative variegations, and, so to speak, modifications of wisdom and intelligence...
For modifications receive their form from the forms which are substances in which they are, and from which they flow. (See Form.)
The forms or substances recipient of life are subjects, and the things which result from their changes and modifications are forces, which are to be called lives...
The colours are modifications of heavenly light, thus of intelligence and wisdom.

For all the colours which appear in Heaven are modifications of heavenly light and flame upon these two planes... Therefore the modifications of this light and flame are variegations of truth and good...
The modification of this light according to the subjects which receive it, which are Angels, presents various phenomena to view; as clouds...
The ideas of thought of the Angels... are also modifications of the light of Heaven; and their affections... are variations of the heat of Heaven.
There is a speech by the face which ceases in what is sonorous modified by ideas.
[151a] (The notion that) the understanding is only a modification of the light from the sun...
The love of the will modifies (the life of man).
In the third period of man's life the will acts into the understanding, and the understanding modifies it.
For thought is only a modification...
The eye has been formed entirely according to all the modifications of the ether; and the ear according to all the modifications of the air.
The rainbows seen by the Angels... all come forth from the light of Heaven and its modification in the spiritual natural sphere there...
These ethers and airs... when modified molecularly give light. AE 726:4. (Under Atmosphere, see these references.)
The light of the sun is the modification or interior action (of its fire) in substances which are outside the sun... called the atmospheres.

The light proceeding (from the Lord as a Sun), which is Divine truth, is the modification or interior action in substances which are outside Him. These substances, in which this modification is effected, are the spiritual atmospheres...
The light of the sun... affects material substances by modifying them, and the heat by changing their states.

Light modifies substances, and heat actuates them... The presence of the sun in the substances, which appears as light, causes the activity of the forces or substances of each individual according to its form in which it is from creation. This is modification.
Newton said, Now I know that colours are modifications of the light in the objects...
The internal sensories are modified and actuated by spiritual light and heat.
